event_text: GoFundMe says an unauthorized party accessed data from the GoFundMe Pro API (first period)
GoFundMe says the unauthorized party accessed GoFundMe Pro data again (second period)
GoFundMe Pro status page reports data failing to sync to Salesforce; it says it is working with Salesforce
notes: The sources do not date when Salesforce disabled the connected app.

event_text: DonorPerfect says it found security threats targeting its reporting technology and took its primary reporting engine offline
DonorPerfect takes its API offline over security concerns
DonorPerfect takes the whole application offline "out of an abundance of caution"
DonorPerfect begins restoring the application in stages
GoFundMe says the GoFundMe Pro packages in Salesforce are restored; the connection stays disabled
GoFundMe posts its Security Notice on its status page
DonorPerfect says four partner integrations are rebuilt but not yet active; the API and mobile app are still unavailable
Salesforce posts a security advisory saying it disabled the GoFundMe Pro connected app and packages after suspicious use of access tokens, and that it was not a Salesforce platform flaw
notes: Posting time from the Salesforce Trust status page.

event_text: Salesforce says it has re-enabled the GoFundMe Pro managed packages; the connected apps stay disabled while its investigation continues
GoFundMe says the GoFundMe Pro to Salesforce integration is still disabled while it works with Salesforce and outside security experts to reinstate it
notes: Posting time from the GoFundMe Pro status page (17:08 PT).

event_text: DonorPerfect says a fifth partner integration is rebuilt and deployed, but none of the five is active yet; the API and mobile app are still unavailable
notes: Posting time from the DonorPerfect status page.

event_text: GoFundMe says the GoFundMe Pro to Salesforce integration remains disabled; the GoFundMe Pro packages in Salesforce stay available
notes: Posting time from the GoFundMe Pro status page (14:37 PT).

event_text: DonorPerfect says the Classic Forms admin area, including its Review and Acceptance Center, is restored; Classic Crowdfunding forms are still unavailable
notes: Posting time from the DonorPerfect status page.

event_text: DonorPerfect says its connection with Givecloud is restored; four other partner integrations are not yet available
notes: Posting time from the DonorPerfect status page (18:08 EST).

event_text: GoFundMe says the GoFundMe Pro to Salesforce integration is available again and organizations can reconnect it
notes: Posting time from the GoFundMe Pro status page (20:17 PST).
